description: This file defines the 'Tracing' class, which manages tracing operations such as starting, stopping, grouping, and collecting stack traces within the Playwright core library. It interacts with external modules like 'artifact' and 'channelOwner' and implements the 'api.Tracing' interface.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: A class that manages tracing sessions, including starting, stopping, grouping, and handling trace artifacts within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to create a Tracing instance from a channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Tracing object with parent, type, guid, and initializer.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new tracing session with optional parameters like name, title, snapshots, screenshots, sources, and live mode.

methods.name: startChunk
methods.description: Begins a new trace chunk with optional name and title.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Creates a new tracing group with a specified name and optional source location.

methods.name: _startCollectingStacks
methods.description: Internal method to initiate stack trace collection, setting tracing state and retrieving stack IDs.

methods.name: stopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current trace chunk, optionally saving to a specified file path.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the tracing session and finalizes trace data, optionally saving to a file.

methods.name: _doStopChunk
methods.description: Handles the logic for stopping a trace chunk, saving or discarding artifacts as needed.

methods.name: _resetStackCounter
methods.description: Resets tracing state flags related to stack collection.
